title: MULTI-OBJECTIVE TASK-AWARE PREDICTOR FOR IMAGE-TEXT ALIGNMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality, safety, and alignment of LVLM-generated text responses to scenery images and requests from the perspective of blind and low-vision (BLV) users, utilizing human judgments across specific dimensions such as direction accuracy, depth accuracy, safety, and sufficiency on the EYE4ALL benchmark.
